newsitem.title: JAPAN: Iwatsu Electric to supply PHS phones to Motorola.
newsitem.headline: Iwatsu Electric to supply PHS phones to Motorola.

text.p: Japanese telecommunications equipment manufacturer Iwatsu Electric Co Ltd said on Wednesday that it would supply telephones compatible with the personal handy phone system (PHS) to Motorola Inc under an original equipment manufacturing agreement.
PHS, launched in July 1995, is a cell-phone system that offers lower rates than conventional portable phones but with shorter range.
A Motorola official said that the company is likely to start selling the phones later this month.
He also said Motorola hopes to introduce its own PHS hand-sets and digital cordless phones in Japan before the end of this year.
